descriptions: memcpy(out, sig, sig_len) writes into params[1].memref.buffer (shared output) but the only size check is conditional (only triggers when params[3].value.b == 0). When value.b != 0, out_len is not validated to be >= sig_len, so a short output buffer can be overrun.

memcpy writes sig_len bytes into out (shared output buffer) but the only size guard is conditional (out_len < sig_len && params[3].value.b == 0). If params[3].value.b != 0, the copy can proceed even when out_len < sig_len, causing an unchecked write to shared memory.

memcpy(out, sig, sig_len) writes into the shared output buffer with length sig_len, but the only size check (out_len < sig_len) is gated by params[3].value.b==0; when value.b!=0, a REE-controlled out_len smaller than sig_len can still reach memcpy, causing an unchecked write past the provided memref size.
